images.prompt:
Premium 2D pixel art for "Remnant: Ascension", a dark biblical-fantasy side-scrolling action RPG. Crisp square pixels, confident dark outlines, rich but limited coherent palette, dramatic rim light, readable when reduced to a 48–60 px tall character. Strict side view facing RIGHT unless stated. Exact equal grid cells as specified, generous transparent margins, nothing crossing a cell edge. No text, labels, grid lines, borders, floor shadows, scenery or watermark. Original designs only: no real-world logos or franchise characters.

5 columns × 2 rows, 256 px cells. Row 1: (1) head and short neck, facing right; (2) torso from shoulders to belt only; (3) hip belt and coat-tail or skirt only; (4) one upper arm, shoulder to elbow, pointing straight down; (5) one forearm ending in a closed gripping hand, pointing down. Row 2: (1) one thigh, hip to knee, pointing down; (2) one lower leg with its boot, toe pointing right; (3) cape or cloak only, attached at top right and trailing down-left; (4) scarf, or for Tirzah her braid, attached at top right and draping down-left; (5) the weapon alone, vertical: sword tip up, or bow with its string on the left. Paint hidden overlaps fully, so joints rotate without holes.

Elior parts v2: a higher-detail repaint of Elior's parts in the layout above, with the same identity and colours (see `README.md` style rule). Gold coat edging and leather texture should read at small size.

Elior: an adult Black man with dark warm-brown skin, short white hair and a short white beard. He wears a charcoal/black coat with gold edges, a burgundy scarf and cape, leather armour and boots, and carries a silver-gold sword.

Transparent PNG. Exact output canvas: 1280 × 512 pixels. Exactly ten separate parts in the 5 × 2 equal grid of 256 × 256 pixel cells. No full character. Each part stays within its cell. No feet baseline applies to this detached-parts sheet.

Status delivered records file delivery, not spec compliance. Claude should follow README.md rejection/re-prompt rules for failed sheets.
